evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present a benchmark for measuring LLMs in closed-loop physical interaction, where models control a harness system connected to real-world components including robotic arms, cameras, and sensors.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: However, current benchmarks largely evaluate LLMs through static text responses, offline tool calls, or simulated tasks, leaving open the question of how well they can act in real physical environments.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: This setting evaluates capabilities beyond language understanding, including grounded perception, action planning, tool selection, spatial reasoning, feedback-driven correction, and robustness to execution uncertainty.
